stories.title: 11-year-old reported missing in Corinna house fire; investigators recover body
stories.summary: Investigators said the boy was home alone when the fire broke out Tuesday evening. A dog was also believed to be inside the home.

stories.title: NEWS CENTER Maine Weather Forecast
stories.summary: Cold and quiet through Thanksgiving. More rain on the way.

stories.title: Annual Pies for Preble churns out dozens of pies ahead of Thanksgiving
stories.summary: Going on 24 years, the tradition ensures those at Preble Street’s annual Thanksgiving dinner get a slice of homemade pie.

stories.title: Sunday River to open after warm November delays season
stories.summary: Sunday River in Newry will open on November 25th after warm weather delays.

stories.title: Investigators seek tips after Salvation Army shed fire in Bangor
stories.summary: The State Fire Marshal's Office is asking anyone who witnessed the Saturday night fire or noticed activity in the area to come forward.

stories.title: Mid-Maine Homeless Shelter CEO arrested
stories.summary: The CEO of Mid-Maine Homeless Shelter, Katie Spencer White, was arrested on charges of tampering with a witness and obstructing government administration.

stories.title: South Portland school board rejects plan to change school district
stories.summary: At a school board meeting on Monday, members decided more time was needed to reconsider reconfiguration.

stories.title: Connecticut man led multi-county chase from Falmouth to Boothbay, police say
stories.summary: Police say the driver reached speeds exceeding 100 mph and went the wrong way on Interstate 295 before spiked strips were used to stop the car

stories.title: Non-stop flights between Maine and Bermuda coming in 2027
stories.summary: BermudAir plans to launch nonstop seasonal service between Portland and Hamilton, Bermuda beginning May 8, 2027

stories.title: Escaped New Hampshire inmate found at Scarborough hotel
stories.summary: Shawn Tarr escaped the Transitional Work Center in Concord, N.H., on Oct. 23. Scarborough police found and arrested him exactly one month later.

stories.title: Downeaster adds seats for Thanksgiving rush
stories.summary: More than 12,000 riders are expected Thanksgiving week, and many trains could sell out. The Downeaster will run four of its usual five round trips on Thanksgiving.

stories.title: Augusta schools approve weekly early release days to address teacher burnout
stories.summary: District leaders say the change will give teachers much-needed planning time, but some parents are concerned about their children's education and childcare costs.
